description: Gilbert Scott's red-brick Gothic Midland Grand Hotel (1868–76) with its 82 m clock tower and lower west tower, steep slate roofs, dormers and chimneys, in front of Barlow's 73 m single-span train shed (1868), a ribbed vault of dark slate and grey glass; the 2007 northern extension is a plain thin glazed roof on columns.
